title: Synchonization related Vulkan Validation errors on standalone Android-based XR devices
body:
### Tested versions

- Godot `master` (5cb1ec590036fba44cdd8e727136ec6c25f11660)

### System information

Samsung Galaxy XR - Android - Vulkan Mobile renderer

### Issue description

I'm using the Vulkan validation Android binaries version 1.4.335.0 from [here](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-ValidationLayers/releases/tag/vulkan-sdk-1.4.335.0), and I've enabled them (including the extra "validate_sync" checks") by running these `adb` commands:

```
adb shell setprop debug.vulkan.layers 'VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation'
adb shell setprop debug.vvl.validate_sync true
```

Running on the Samsung Galaxy XR with the simplest possible project, I get this additional validation error (which I otherwise wouldn't get if I didn't enable the "validate_sync" checks):

```
E 0:00:04:889   _debug_messenger_callback: VALIDATION - Message Id Number: 1544472022 | Message Id Name: SYNC-HAZARD-WRITE-AFTER-WRITE
	vkQueueSubmit(): WRITE_AFTER_WRITE hazard detected. vkCmdBeginRenderPass[Command Graph (L2) (Draw)] (from VkCommandBuffer 0xb4000074dd02f350 submitted on the current VkQueue 0xb4000074dd02f3d0) writes to resource, which was previously written during an image layout transition initiated by vkCmdEndRenderPass[Command Graph (L2) (Draw)] (from VkCommandBuffer 0xb4000074dd02f3b0 submitted on VkQueue 0xb4000074dd02f3d0). 
No sufficient synchronization is present to ensure that a write (VK_ACCESS_2_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT) at VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT does not conflict with a prior layout transition.
	Objects - 2
		Object[0] - VK_OBJECT_TYPE_QUEUE, Handle -5476376644958358576
		Object[1] - VK_OBJECT_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER, Handle -5476376644958358704
  <C++ Source>  drivers/vulkan/rendering_context_driver_vulkan.cpp:642 @ _debug_messenger_callback()
```

It happens 10 times before it stops logging it, which leads me to believe it happens every frame.

If I rebuild Godot with the `RENDER_GRAPH_FULL_BARRIERS` and `FORCE_FULL_ACCESS_BITS` defines enabled, then the error goes away, which leads me to believe that this is a Godot bug rather than a bug in the OpenXR runtime.

(Note: I discovered this while looking into https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/113778, however, it isn't the cause of that issue, since enabling the afformentioned defines doesn't fix that issue.)

I get the exact same error repeated just as much on the Meta Quest Pro. But on the Meta Quest 3, I get similar but different errors, and they don't appear to recur every frame - they just happen 5 times at the very beginning.

This is using the simplest possible project - most rendering features are disabled. So, MSAA is disabled, VRS is disabled, etc.

Interestingly, I tried my test project on my Android phone (of course, the XR stuff won't work, but it does render), and it didn't give these errors there. So, it does seem to be specific to XR somehow.

### Steps to reproduce

The simplest "box hands" test project will cause the issue.

An MRP is attached below.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Here's an MRP: [galaxy-xr-empty.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24200703/galaxy-xr-empty.zip)

It needs godot_openxr_vendors v4.2.2, which isn't in the ZIP to save space, but you can download it via the asset library.
